role: Local legislative body, City of Richmond
stance_basis: paraphrase states Council accepted need and desirability of the program and official approval expected
summary: The Richmond City Council is described as having accepted the need and desirability of the Randolph Conservation and Redevelopment Program, as evidenced by its inclusion in the Community Renewal Program and the five-year Capital Improvement Program. Official local approval by the City Council was expected in February 1973, and city departments were described as prepared to support the project with necessary public works and community facilities improvements.
